name: Thompson NFA Regex Engine
description: Repair alternation splitting, postfix precedence, Star loop-back edges, transitive epsilon closure, unanchored search, and leftmost-longest findall semantics.
planted_defect: concat does not stop at |, parsing alternation as literal pipe
Star fragment has no loop-back edge (matches zero-or-one)
epsilon closure is single-hop, breaking nested groups
findall returns the shortest end, fragmenting matches
